main_text.l: spiratorijs ab ea causa impressa, est abigenda. Si vero fit per consensum partium spirita lium cum alijs primario affectis: praesertim quae ab illis motis mouentur, vt ventriculo, hepate, liene, & si gurgulio, aut caput destil let, primum his est succurrendum: deinde si qua dispositio partibus respiratorijs inhaesit, tolleda: si a pleuritide est, aut peripneumonia per harum phlegmonarum curationem post dicendam prospicitur: vt si a pure collecto in thorace, aut pulmone est tussis, curationem eius in empyemate audies: si a rupta in pulmo ne vena, in sputo sanguinis: si a catarrho, is tibi ante est curandus, vt dixi. Si autem tussis est ob alium proprium partium spiritalium affectum, id est intemperies calida, frigida, humida, sicca, vel sola, vel cum materia: omnis per contrarium corrigenda. Si enim frigida sola, calidis sumptis, & admotis: vt dia moscho dulci, amaro, & alijs calidis, ouo sor bili, & vino, reliquaque victus ratione calida: quae si imbecilla est, etiam anhelitus cohi bitio sanat: pulmone, per retentam expirandā

page.notes: The marginal note "Paulus." is placed beside the line "deinde si". The catchword "Q 5" at the foot right is likely a signature mark and is recorded here as printed. Some words in the Latin are printed with long s forms rendered as s.
